hypothesis.statement: Held-out TOTAL_SELECTION_EFFECT programmes classified prospectively as MULTI_COMPONENT_OR_ASSEMBLAGE will more often contain at least one bidirectionally uncertainty-supported sign reversal than programmes classified as SINGLE_REGISTERED_MODIFIER.

MULTI_COMPONENT_OR_ASSEMBLAGE.rule: Before outcome-sign inspection, the repeated-context design varies at least two registered ecological components in a crossed design, changes consumer identity/composition, or is a spatial mosaic with source-documented variation in at least two ecological components.

SINGLE_REGISTERED_MODIFIER.rule: Before outcome-sign inspection, one registered ecological modifier is experimentally manipulated or prospectively stratified while the focal total-selection estimand and trait axis are held comparable.

UNRESOLVED_CONTEXT_DIMENSIONALITY.rule: The context label is observational or composite and the source does not support assignment to one of the two primary predictor classes without inspecting outcome signs.

outcome_rule.axis_level_strong_reversal: At least one context has supported positive total selection and at least one context has supported negative total selection on the same canonical trait axis.
supported_direction_sources: reported p<0.05 paired with the sign of the reported coefficient
outcome_rule.programme_level_outcome: YES if at least one repeated canonical axis satisfies axis_level_strong_reversal; otherwise NO after all qualified repeated axes in the programme are adjudicated.

admission_rules: programme first qualifies for TOTAL_SELECTION_EFFECT after baseline_commit_sha
programme is independent of every development_programme
same-axis and common-outcome qualification rules remain unchanged
context predictor class is frozen before outcome-sign adjudication
at least one canonical trait axis has two or more comparable total-selection contexts
